rule: A deployed version passes when, for each case, its answer carries the same facts as tool_output.

cases.question: Someone asks which access review stages are recorded as complete and whether anomaly review, evidence collection or decision recording is next. Use the SecurityAccessReview tool on the sample.
cases.tool_output:
{
  "completed": [
    "Load access list"
  ],
  "external_work_performed": false,
  "next_stage": "Detect anomalies",
  "review": "Contoso sample quarterly review",
  "scope": "Design-only checklist; no access decision is made or recorded.",
  "stages": [
    "Load access list",
    "Detect anomalies",
    "Collect evidence",
    "Record decision"
  ]
}
cases.local_answer:
Only **Load access list** is recorded as complete for the Contoso sample quarterly review.

**Anomaly review (Detect anomalies) is next.** Evidence collection and decision recording come after it.

This is a design-only checklist: no external work has been performed and no access decision has been made or recorded.
